name: Hitting Size / Log Size Ratio (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the addressing class $\mathrm{ADDRESSING}_n$, $\mathrm{HT}=2^{\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor}$ while the log size ratio $\log(2^{\lfloor\log n\rfloor}-1)/\log(n+\lfloor\log n\rfloor+1)$ is bounded by one.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the common-core cube $\mathcal Q^{\cap}_n$, the log size ratio is $\log(2^n-1)/\log(n+2)=\Theta(n/\log n)$, while $\mathrm{HT}=1$.
proof: The addressing and common-core-cube value calculations give gaps whose ratios diverge in the two opposite directions.
